source.stem: Which property of aluminium makes it useful in the manufacture of aircraft?

intelligence.enrichment: Some natural resources get replenished through natural processes over a reasonable period of time. Fossil fuels take millions of years to form, are limited, get exhausted once used, and are not replenished within a reasonable period of time. If a resource is replenished naturally within a reasonable time, it is renewable; if it is limited, exhausted by use, and not replenished in a reasonable time, it is non-renewable. The learner correctly applies this rule: Some natural resources get replenished through natural processes over a reasonable period of time. Fossil fuels take millions of years to form, are limited, get exhausted once used, and are not replenished within a reasonable period of time. Renewable means useful every day, and non-renewable means not useful.
